09Questions

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. But you need to be willing to understand the basics.

Is this a Claude Code course?

No. Claude Code is one tool inside the workflow.

What if another tool becomes better next month?

Great. We’ll use the better tool. The process matters more than the brand name.

Is this only for web designers?

It is mainly for product, UI and web designers who want to ship more of their own work.

Do I keep access?

Yes. All future course updates are included.
